title: Privacy preferences button is missing on /privacy/firefox/
body:
## Description

When visiting the `/privacy/firefox/` page I noticed there's a JS error in the console. I believe this is preventing the privacy choices widget from being displayed on the page.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Visit https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/privacy/firefox/

### Expected result

There's should be a button that offers choice for how Firefox shares data:

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/400117/65317225-54269180-db93-11e9-89ae-b698c4f7d10e.png)

### Actual result

There's no button displayed. Opening the web console, there's a JS error:

```
TypeError: e[0] is undefined
```

Running locally this is a little more descriptive:

```
TypeError: topicHeaders[0] is undefined
```

### Environment

Any browser
